lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba4Mg2Cu2O8 (reduced formula Ba2MgCuO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Mg each adopt tetrahedral coordination by four O neighbors, while Ba exhibits a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement. The same analysis identifies corner-sharing between Cu and Mg tetrahedra, and face-sharing between the Ba 12-vertex polyhedra and both Cu and Mg tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites.
